# TopSAAS

> TopSAAS is a curated leaderboard, discovery engine, and launchpad for modern SaaS products, AI tools, developer utilities, and open-source software starters.

TopSAAS connects software founders with early adopters, technical buyers, investors, and builders. The directory is ranked by community upvotes, verified launches, and engagement rather than paid placement, and it pairs a product leaderboard with an open-source starter catalog.

## Core pages

- [Homepage and product leaderboard](https://www.topsaas.space/): curated SaaS and AI product rankings, search, weekly spotlights, and the open-source starter catalog.
- [SaaS Ideas catalog](https://www.topsaas.space/ideas): thousands of curated open-source repositories that can serve as the foundation for a SaaS product, grouped by category with stars, forks, license, health score, and a self-hosting verdict.
- [Trending open-source projects](https://www.topsaas.space/trending): repositories that pushed code in the last 90 days, ranked by star velocity weighted with recency. Includes a Newest tab and category filters.
- [Build guides](https://www.topsaas.space/guides): original walkthroughs that ship a working product on one curated repository.
- [Founder blog](https://www.topsaas.space/blog): launch checklists, growth playbooks, high-DR directory guides, and open-source stacks for bootstrapped founders.
- [Product directory](https://www.topsaas.space/product-directory): SaaS directories and launch platforms ranked by Ahrefs Domain Rating, with price, link type, directory type, and a submission guide for every entry.
- [Pricing](https://www.topsaas.space/pricing): free listings, Verified Launch, and featured placement pricing.
- [Submit a product](https://www.topsaas.space/submit): founder submission flow with media, demo video, offer details, and founder profile.
- [MRR calculator](https://www.topsaas.space/mrr-calculator): free browser-based monthly recurring revenue and annual run rate calculator.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.topsaas.space/privacy): data collection, storage, and deletion rights.
- [Terms of service](https://www.topsaas.space/terms): submission guidelines, fair play rules, and listing terms.

## Repo detail pages

Every curated repository has its own indexable page with an editorial write-up, license, language breakdown, star and fork counts, health score, self-hosting verdict, clone command, and similar projects.

- [refinedev/refine](https://www.topsaas.space/repo/refinedev/refine): React framework for internal tools and admin panels.
- [t3-oss/create-t3-app](https://www.topsaas.space/repo/t3-oss/create-t3-app): full-stack TypeScript SaaS starter.
- [n8n-io/n8n](https://www.topsaas.space/repo/n8n-io/n8n): workflow automation with a visual builder.
- [Browse all repositories](https://www.topsaas.space/ideas): full starter catalog with category filters.

## Build guides

- [Ship an admin dashboard with refine](https://www.topsaas.space/guides/refine-admin-dashboard): beginner, about 8 to 12 hours.
- [Automate SaaS operations with n8n](https://www.topsaas.space/guides/n8n-automation-mvp): beginner, about 4 to 6 hours.
- [Launch a full-stack SaaS with create-t3-app](https://www.topsaas.space/guides/create-t3-app-fullstack-saas): intermediate, about a weekend.

Each guide includes copy-paste commands, a production checklist, customization notes, a foundation repo link, and a guide-specific FAQ.

## Free SaaS metrics reference

- [SaaS MRR calculator](https://www.topsaas.space/mrr-calculator): calculates MRR and ARR in the browser with no sign-up.
- Core formula: `MRR = average revenue per customer x number of active paying customers`.
- Annual run rate: `ARR = MRR x 12`.
- Average revenue per account: `ARPA = MRR / active paying customers`.
- Net new MRR: `new MRR + expansion MRR + reactivation MRR - contraction MRR - churned MRR`.
- SaaS quick ratio: `(new MRR + expansion MRR) / (churned MRR + contraction MRR)`.
- Annual plan conversion: divide the annual price by 12. A $1,200 annual plan contributes $100 to MRR.

## Trending ranking reference

- [Trending projects](https://www.topsaas.space/trending) ranks curated repositories by current momentum.
- Eligibility: a GitHub push inside the last 90 days.
- Trend score: `log10((stars / max(repository age in years, 0.25)) + 1) x recency weight`.
- Recency weights: 7 days or less = 1.00; 8 to 14 days = 0.85; 15 to 30 days = 0.70; 31 to 60 days = 0.55; 61 to 90 days = 0.40.
- Health score: 0 to 100 from activity 40, popularity 25, engagement 15, issue load 10, and open-source hygiene 10. Archived projects are capped at 30.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- [llms-full.txt](https://www.topsaas.space/llms-full.txt): full platform specification, data schema, and endpoint reference.
- [ai.txt](https://www.topsaas.space/ai.txt): AI crawler and usage policy.
- [ai-snapshot.json](https://www.topsaas.space/ai-snapshot.json): structured platform metrics and endpoint catalog.
- [catalog.md](https://www.topsaas.space/catalog.md): Markdown table of ranked products.
- [openapi.json](https://www.topsaas.space/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 REST API specification.
- [products.json](https://www.topsaas.space/products.json): public JSON feed of ranked products.
